label: Thin epistemic reasons from warranted acceptance and surviving evidential support
meaning: The two necessity and attribution assumptions recover a thin reason for the same subject and content as a warranted acceptance. If a specified basis was undercut for that subject, the surviving basis is distinct. Result 1db47fd9 supplies the acceptance conditionally but its eligible-uptake input already includes a reason. That producer adds no independent grounds for thin F6. Independently assessing an actual warranted acceptance is a separate application option.
